project.description: Job to adjust the variable/subject counts for each study to reflect what is available in pic-sure Pre-reqs: ingestion pipeline should be run

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash
### assume etl role aws sts assume-role --duration-seconds 900 --role-arn arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl --role-session-name "s3-test" > assume-role-output.txt
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=`grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=`grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=`grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` aws s3 cp ${s3_bucket}/general/resources/Managed_Inputs.csv Managed_Inputs.csv aws s3 cp ${s3_bucket}/general/data/consents.csv consents.csv aws s3 cp ${s3_bucket}/general/hpds/javabin/columnMeta/columnMeta.csv columnMeta.csv unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID unset AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY unset AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
csvcut -c "Study Abbreviated Name","Study Identifier","Data is ready to process","Data Processed","Study Type","Has Multi" Managed_Inputs.csv > inputs.csv IFS=',' [ ! -f inputs.csv ] while read abv id data_ready data_processed study_type has_multi do if [[ "${data_ready,,}" == "yes" ]]; then mkdir ${id} echo "Processing ${id}" curl --retry 5 --max-time 10 --retry-connrefused --retry-delay 0 --show-error --silent $api/consent?datasetRef=${id} > $id/consent_list.json || exit 255 LENGTH=$((`jq '. | length' $id/consent_list.json`)) if [[ $? != 0 ]] || [[ $LENGTH == 0 ]] then echo "Missing expected consent information for ${id} in db" exit 255;
else export LENGTH echo "Found ${LENGTH} consents for ${id} in database" export ITER=$(($LENGTH-1)) fi
for ((i = 0 ; i < $LENGTH ; i++ )); do
consent=`jq -r ".["${i}"].consentCode" $id/consent_list.json` if [[ $? != 0 ]] || [[ -z $consent ]] then if [[ "${study_type,,}" == "public" ]]; then echo "Processing ${id} as a public study" export consent="" else echo "Unable to get consent code from consent list- failing" exit 255 fi else export consent echo "Processing counts for: id: $id consent: $consent" fi
grep -i $id.$consent consents.csv | sort -u > $id/consents_$i.csv participantcount=`wc -l < $id/consents_$i.csv` if [[ $? != 0 ]] || [[ $participantcount == 0 ]] || [[ -z $participantcount ]] then #handling for noncompliant studies without subject multis which do not get added to general consents.csv #(these consents are added to allConcepts separately during global var merge and will only ever have one consent) echo "No participants found in standard consents.csv. Processing counts for id: $id as public/noncompliant study" aws sts assume-role --duration-seconds 3600 --role-arn arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl --role-session-name "s3-test" > assume-role-output.txt export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=`grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=`grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=`grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` aws s3 cp ${s3_bucket}/${abv,,}/data/${abv^^}_PatientMapping.v2.csv ./${id}/${abv^^}_PatientMapping.v2.csv || exit 255 unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID unset AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY unset AWS_SESSION_TOKEN participantcount=`wc -l < ${id}/${abv^^}_PatientMapping.v2.csv` if [[ $? != 0 ]] || [[ $participantcount == 0 ]] || [[ -z $participantcount ]] then echo "Unable to get participant count- failing" exit 255 else export participantcount fi else export participantcount echo "Participant count " $participantcount fi
grep "^\"*\\\\${id}\\\\" columnMeta.csv > ${id}/vars.csv varcount=`wc -l < ${id}/vars.csv` echo varcount $varcount if [[ $? != 0 ]] || [[ $varcount == 0 ]] || [[ -z $varcount ]]; then echo "No variables found for ${id} which was marked as ready for ingestion" exit 255 else export varcount echo "Variable count " $varcount fi
curl --retry 5 --max-time 10 --retry-connrefused --retry-delay 0 --show-error --silent --request PUT --data-urlencode "datasetRef=${id}" --data-urlencode "consentCode=${consent}" \ --data-urlencode "participantCount=${participantcount}" --data-urlencode "variableCount=${varcount}" ${api}/consent/counts || exit 255
unset participantcount unset varcount
done fi done < inputs.csv
